messages:
ella (Design): quick sync about the Settings form UX — need to decide on how we mark mandatory fields, how validation is surfaced across a 3-step wizard, and final wording for the team-delete flow. trying to avoid multiple small patterns.
mo (PM): got it. what are the concrete options so we can pick one?
nina (DevEx): accessibility-first reminder: whatever we pick must be announced reliably by screen readers and should not rely on color alone. also consider touch targets on mobile.
ravi (Eng): from the infra side we can support either inline-only errors, or inline + a masthead summary that lists issues. cost is mainly in focus management and ensuring we don't re-render the whole form on each keystroke.
ella (Design): option 1 = small visible badge "Required" (like a muted pill) next to the label; SR reads via sr-only text + aria-required. option 2 = traditional asterisk but with a short legend at the top for long forms. option 3 = no visual marker, rely on helper copy (not ideal).
ella (Design): for compact lists I prefer the badge — clear at a glance and reads well on mobile. for long pages, legend reduces repetitive microcopy.
mo (PM): and validation behavior for the multi-step wizard?
ella (Design): single-step pages -> inline errors below fields. multi-step wizard -> a compact validation masthead at the top of the step that says e.g. "2 issues on this page". clicking it expands a list of short anchors that jump to each field and focus it.
nina (DevEx): masthead should be an aria-live region so SR users are notified when it appears, and links should move keyboard focus to the target field and announce label+error. also ensure each invalid input has aria-describedby pointing to the error.
ravi (Eng): implementation note: we'll add data-error-anchor attributes on the inputs and one handler to manage focus + smooth scroll. debounce validation to avoid noisy masthead updates. avoid DOM churn on every keystroke.
ella (Design): minor stylistic call: the masthead copy should be concise — "2 issues on this step" + first-line preview. avoid showing full error text in the masthead to keep it scannable.
mo (PM): sounds good. delete-team modal: current label is just "Delete team" which feels terse. suggestions?
ella (Design): candidate labels: "Delete team", "Delete team and data", "Permanently delete team". my bias is explicit: users should immediately understand the permanence.
nina (DevEx): typed-confirm is strong for org-level actions but we must surface clear instructions and make the confirm input accessible. also the primary CTA should be disabled until the typed value matches. announce mismatch via role=alert.
ravi (Eng): backend supports a 14-day recovery window for team deletes. we can mention that in the copy if product wants. typed confirm can be gated by team size or org role. client-side match check is simple, server-side check only when action is submitted.
ella (Design): proposed modal structure:
- Title: "Permanently delete team"
- Body: "This will permanently delete the team and associated data. This action cannot be undone. To confirm, type the team slug:\n"
- Input label: "Enter team slug to confirm"
- Primary: "Delete team" (danger, disabled until match). Secondary: "Cancel"
mo (PM): prefer "team name" vs "slug"? users might not know slug. probably use "team name" unless the UI exposes slugs prominently. also mention "Items may be recoverable for 14 days" only if we have soft-delete guarantees. I'll check with Legal/Product.
nina (DevEx): accessibility checklist to include in the ticket: focus trap inside modal, aria-describedby linking to the explanatory text, primary button has aria-disabled until match, mismatch errors announced with role=alert, and keyboard-only flow documented. include instructions for voiceover users.
ravi (Eng): perf note: masthead anchor clicks should not cause a full-form rehydrate. we'll implement a direct DOM focus jump. also avoid running full validation on every keystroke by throttling to 300ms.
access-bot: reminder: run axe regression after PR is open.
ella (Design): decision summary: for compact/settings lists use a small "Required" badge with sr-only helper; for long/dense pages provide a legend explaining the badge/asterisk. validation: inline errors for single-step, compact masthead with anchors + focus-jump for multi-step. delete modal: "Permanently delete team" with typed-confirm for org-level deletes, mention 14-day recovery only if product confirms. i'll update the spec and Figma and include the a11y checklist.
mo (PM): thanks — i'll confirm the recovery language and the threshold for typed-confirm, then update the product doc.
nina (DevEx): i'll add accessibility acceptance criteria and a keyboard test plan to the ticket.
ravi (Eng): i'll add debounce + focus-jump requirements to the implementation notes.
ella (Design): thanks everyone :sparkles: i'll post the updated spec in the ticket when ready.
